teams.product_capability: Doctrinal-lineage / citation-heritage navigation at full corpus scale: the ability to surface a decision's true legal ancestors and descendants (which precedents it follows, distinguishes, criticizes) as a separable citation-heritage map view, and to strengthen the citation-based primary representation and its evaluation.
teams.question: Can citation extraction + resolution be EXTENDED from the 250-decision frozen benchmark seed (original_stats: total_decisions=250; 174 decisions with outgoing citations; 2,019/2,105 references resolved at 95.9%) AND INTEGRATED with the existing but NON-ADOPTED corpus-scale graph (evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_graph_174k.json: 5,031 source decisions, 7,799 edges, 1,286 nodes with outdegree>=2; citation_pairs_174k_full.json: 137,314 positive pairs) into a corpus-scale ADOPTED decision-to-decision graph, and does that integrated graph (a) supply enough shared>=2 citation pairs to empirically validate or falsify the dense center_projected_64dim citation-heritage criterion (AUC>=0.75), and (b) improve the frozen TF-IDF primary citation-heritage AUC above 0.7296?
teams.hypothesis: The ACCEPTED evaluation retraction (2026-10-10) — all 174k dense citation-heritage runs FAILED with 'Insufficient valid pairs' and prior AUC 0.7667-0.8182 were retracted — is caused by the frozen benchmark using only a 250-decision seed graph and by the existing corpus-scale extraction (5,031 sources / 137,314 pairs, already built by evaluation/evaluation/build_174k_citation_graph.py) never being ADOPTED into the frozen harness — not by a limitation of dense embeddings. Extending that existing pipeline (it already computes over all 2000-2026 bger_ metadata via citation_to_decision_id.json) and integrating its output into the frozen benchmark will make the citation-heritage criterion testable and improve TF-IDF citation-heritage retrieval; if coverage stays low after integration, the citation-heritage claim is genuinely dead and must remain retracted.
teams.why_now: Newer ACCEPTED evaluation evidence (core/evaluation/state/evaluation.json, EVAL_FREEZE_TFIDF_174K_BASELINE_20261010, 2026-10-10) explicitly names citation-graph coverage as the binding blocker for the citation-heritage capability and retracts the prior dense-superiority claim. The frozen benchmark graph is only a 250-decision seed (original_stats.total_decisions=250), yet accepted artifacts already contain a corpus-scale graph (5,031 sources / 7,799 edges / 137,314 pairs) that was produced but never adopted. This integration/adoption bottleneck is concrete, product-relevant, and independent of the dense-embedding pipeline and of section extraction.
teams.non_duplication: Corpus lane (RUN) is chartered ONLY for 174k section extraction, the BGE/bger ID crosswalk, and the 2024-2026 parquet/embeddings — NOT citation-graph construction. legal-distance is PAUSED and owns embedding/distance benchmarking, not graph construction; fractal-map owns clustering; evaluation owns the harness; product owns UI. No active lane or team currently builds or ADOPTS a corpus-scale citation graph. THIS TEAM DOES NOT REBUILD WHAT EXISTS: it EXTENDS and INTEGRATES evaluation/evaluation/build_174k_citation_graph.py and its existing outputs (evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_graph_174k.json — 5,031 sources, 7,799 edges, 1,286 outdegree>=2 — and citation_pairs_174k_full.json — 137,314 positive pairs), and must first document and quantify why those outputs were NOT adopted into the frozen benchmark (suspected ID-scheme/resolution/coverage gaps) before adding any new extraction.
dependencies: corpus/normalization/canonical pinned 174k corpus (bge_ decision IDs; canonical JSONL covers 2000-2026; full_text coverage 1.0; cited_decisions field coverage 0.526) and evaluation metadata_174k (bger_ decision IDs, 173,963, years 2000-2026)
corpus/normalization/canonical/resolved_full/citation_to_decision_id.json and citation_graph_resolved.json (250-decision seed; 2,019/2,105 refs resolved; resolution 95.9%)

EXISTING non-adopted corpus-scale graph to extend: evaluation/evaluation/build_174k_citation_graph.py, evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_graph_174k.json (5,031 sources / 7,799 edges / 1,286 outdegree>=2), citation_pairs_174k_full.json (137,314 positive pairs)

frozen evaluation harness: evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_pairs_174k.json (in_citation_graph=174, resolved_citations_in_corpus=924) and results/evaluation/citation_heritage_174k_tfidf_latest.json (TF-IDF citation-heritage AUC=0.7296)
center_projected_64dim dense embeddings for the 2000-2021 subset (for dense citation-heritage validation)
frozen benchmark rule from core/evaluation/state/evaluation.json (citation-heritage threshold AUC>=0.75, shared>=2 citation pairs)
teams.acceptance_test: (1) Corpus-scale citation graph BUILT/ADOPTED with coverage reported against the theoretical ceiling: at least 45,800 decisions carrying >=1 resolved outgoing edge (>=50% of the ~91,583 maximum implied by cited_decisions field coverage 0.526 over 174,113 decisions), EXTENDING the existing 5,031-source graph, OR a documented, reproducible coverage ceiling with quantified resolution failure modes; resolution rate reported against the 95.9% seed baseline. (2) Citation-heritage AUC on shared>=2 citation pairs computed on a held-out split, using the frozen harness, with >=2000 evaluable pairs. (3) EITHER frozen TF-IDF primary citation-heritage AUC improves above 0.7296 OR dense center_projected_64dim reaches the 0.75 criterion. (4) Artifacts serialized, deterministically reproducible, provenance-preserved, and the adoption status of the existing 5,031-source graph explicitly documented. (5) Frozen benchmark NOT weakened; all negative results preserved.
teams.stop_promote_rule: PROMOTE (hand graph + metrics to fractal-map/legal-distance/evaluation/product as an accepted artifact) if acceptance (1)+(2) pass and (3) shows improvement or dense>=0.75. TERMINATE if the integrated graph cannot exceed 10,000 decisions with resolved outgoing edges (≈2x the existing 5,031-source graph) within the charter window, or if citation-heritage AUC does not exceed the frozen 0.7296 — record the negative result and leave the dense citation-heritage claim retracted. A successor hypothesis requires a NEW charter_version.

policy: Create specialized teams only for concrete product-relevant hypotheses or bottlenecks. Parallelism should grow with credible independent paths, not curiosity.
